description: A guide that asks for many fast unit tests, fewer slice and integration tests and a handful of end-to-end tests.
A test that starts only one layer of the application, such as the web layer with @WebMvcTest, instead of the whole context.
A test that loads the real application context, often with a real database in a container, to check that layers work together.
A test that drives the built client in a real browser against a running API to check a full user journey.
A test that checks one side of an API against the written agreement of paths, fields and status codes without starting the other side.
A test that passes and fails without any code change, usually because of time, shared data, ordering or fixed waits.
A java.time.Clock passed in as a dependency so a test can fix the current time.
